I replied to Tobias in a thread in #central-team to say I'd noted the 382 seats for Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal.

No file was updated. I can't edit the shared files, so the only record is his message and my reply in that thread. I couldn't check the number against anything either: there are no Marrow account files I can see, or any account files at all. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
